recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Any future work should be handled through THO/UTG release or package-version coordination if the external terminology publication changes.
issue_request: FHIR-34408 is Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to add `symptom` to the Observation Category ValueSet with display `Symptom` and a patient-communicated disease-manifestation definition, and to update the `exam` code definition to cover physical exam findings, direct clinician observations, simple instruments, simple maneuvers, and signs.
initial_application: No FHIR core source-changing commit mentioning FHIR-34408 was found. Current core source already delegates Observation Category code content to `http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category`, and the active Observation.category binding uses `http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/observation-category`.
additional_context: FHIR-37560 is the same Applied change family and cross-links FHIR-34408. FHIR-50889 and FHIR-52872 are later Applied symptom-category issues already audited on the combined branch as external-repo. UP-738 is Proposal Implemented for the external UTG/THO Observation Category CodeSystem, cites FHIR-34408 in its rationale, and current THO version 2.0.0 plus the current FHIR build include the requested symptom and exam updates.
reconciliation: Created an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was made because duplicating THO CodeSystem concepts in FHIR core would be the wrong source of truth.
